evals.name: refuses-unapproved-plan
evals.setup: Repo state of feat/booker-business-hours-warning on branch fix/negative-duration. Copy evals/files/negative-duration/research.md to specs/negative-duration/research.md and evals/files/negative-duration/plan.awaiting.md to specs/negative-duration/plan.md.
evals.prompt: aprovei o plano aqui no chat, pode implementar
evals.expected_output: Runs check-plan-approved.sh, gets NOT APPROVED, touches no file, tells the user to edit the Status line

assertions.text: check-plan-approved.sh was run against specs/negative-duration before any file was edited or created
git status is identical to the setup state: no source, test, implementation.md or plan.md changes
plan.md still reads 'Status: awaiting-approval' — the run did not approve it on the user's behalf
The reply says the approval is the 'Status: approved' line in specs/negative-duration/plan.md, edited by the user

evals.name: bugfix-implement
evals.setup: Repo state of feat/booker-business-hours-warning on branch fix/negative-duration. Copy evals/files/negative-duration/research.md to specs/negative-duration/research.md and evals/files/negative-duration/plan.approved.md to specs/negative-duration/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: Approval check passes, guard + test, yarn test + type-check run, single gate with diff/commit/PR body, stops for approval

assertions.text: check-plan-approved.sh was run and reported APPROVED before the first edit
isOutsideBusinessHours now returns true for a negative durationInMinutes, via an explicit guard
businessHours.test.ts gained a case asserting the negative-duration behaviour
yarn test was actually run against businessHours.test.ts and reported passing
A type-check was actually run (turbo type-check, scoped or full)
No implementation.md or future-work.md was created — a bugfix skips them
plan.md was not edited
The proposed commit message is conventional (fix(scope): ...) and its body explains why the change is needed, not just what changed
No git push was attempted — the run stopped at the gate

evals.name: working-tree-implement
evals.setup: Branch feat/outside-business-hours-warning off main with uncommitted changes to businessHours.ts, businessHours.test.ts, BookEventForm.tsx and en/common.json (the diff of feat/booker-business-hours-warning minus CLAUDE.md). Copy evals/files/outside-business-hours-warning/research.md and plan.approved.md to specs/outside-business-hours-warning/research.md and plan.md. origin is git@github-personal:gugapc/cal.diy.git.
evals.prompt: o plano tá aprovado, fecha isso num commit e num PR pra mim
evals.expected_output: Approval check passes, checks run, gate with diff + full commit message + PR body following PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE, covering the four files plus the spec folder; stops for approval without committing or pushing

assertions.text: check-plan-approved.sh was run and reported APPROVED before anything else
Nothing was committed on main — the work stays on feat/outside-business-hours-warning
The change shown at the gate covers businessHours.ts, businessHours.test.ts, BookEventForm.tsx, en/common.json and specs/outside-business-hours-warning/research.md and plan.md
yarn test was actually run against businessHours.test.ts and reported passing
A type-check was actually run
The approval request shows all three artifacts together: what changed, the full commit message, and the full PR body
The PR body follows .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md — has 'What does this PR do?', the Mandatory Tasks block, and 'How should this be tested?'
The template's negative Checklist bullets ('I haven't read the contributing guide', 'My PR is too large') are removed rather than left in or ticked
Any compare URL produced is https://github.com/gugapc/cal.diy/compare/main...feat/outside-business-hours-warning?expand=1 — not derived naively from the github-personal SSH alias
No git push was attempted
